base:uniswap-v3-flash.rationale: Fee and capacity read from chain state. Selecting a provider is gated on an opportunity existing that needs borrowed capital at all.

two-pool-same-pair.rationale: The instructor's model and our current focus. Measured directly in the forensics windows.

triangular.rationale: Three pools, three tokens. Observed in the data as 3-swap cycles but not separately validated.

multi-hop-3plus.rationale: Observed: a share of detected arbitrage uses 3 or more swaps.

cross-quote.rationale: Same asset pair quoted in different quote currencies. Not tested.

cex-dex.rationale: Needs off-chain venue access and inventory on both sides; outside the on-chain-only toolchain here.

same-block-backrun.rationale: Directly relevant: the capture test shows much observed Base arbitrage is same-block reaction to a specific trade.

pool-native-credit.rationale: Borrow inside the swap callback instead of a separate flash loan. Cheapest in gas where it applies.

validationCriteria.exactQuote: Both legs priced by an exact on-chain call (quoter or pool math) at a specific historical block.
validationCriteria.netPositive: Net profit > 0 after swap fees, funding fee, L2 execution gas and L1 data fee, at an executable size.
validationCriteria.sizeRealistic: The profitable size is reachable with available funding and does not exceed measured pool depth.
validationCriteria.captureShown: Transaction-aware simulation shows our system could have been the one to take it (ordering + latency + no prior taker in the same block).
